proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {i, j, k} := by decide +revert
  have hH : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.circumcenter = (t.points i -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    rw [t.orthocenter_vsub_circumcenter_eq_sum_vsub, hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton, add_assoc]
  have hn : ∀ l, ‖t.points l -ᵥ t.circumcenter‖ = t.circumradius := by
    intro l; rw [← dist_eq_norm_vsub]; exact t.dist_circumcenter_eq_circumradius l
  have d : ∀ l m, dist (t.points l) (t.points m) ^ 2 = 2 * t.circumradius ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (t.points l -ᵥ t.circumcenter) (t.points m -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    intro l m
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V (t.points l) (t.points m), ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right (t.points l) (t.points m) t.circumcenter, norm_sub_sq_real, hn, hn]
    ring
  rw [d, d, d, dist_comm, dist_eq_norm_vsub V t.orthocenter, hH, norm_add_sq_real, norm_add_sq_real, hn, hn, hn, inner_add_left, real_inner_comm (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) (t.points i -ᵥ t.circumcenter)]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist t.circumcenter t.orthocenter ^ 2 = 9 * t.circumradius ^ 2 - (dist (t.points i) (t.points j) ^ 2 + dist (t.points j) (t.points k) ^ 2 + dist (t.points k) (t.points i) ^ 2)
